title: For a morphism of fibred categories the lower shriek functors on modules and abelian sheaves exist and are compatible, derived or not
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

difficulty_reason: The lemma assembles the lower shriek functors for a morphism of fibred categories: existence of g_! and g_!^Ab and of their derived versions, and the commutativity of the two diagrams relating them to the abelian-sheaf versions (statement lines 9828-9864). The proof (proof lines 9866-9928) obtains existence from continuity and cocontinuity of u, reduces both commutativity assertions to one isomorphism on extension-by-zero sheaves, localises using exactness of j_! and uniqueness of adjoints, and closes with a Yoneda computation whose chain of adjunctions identifies Hom(L(g')^Ab_!O_{U'}, E) with Hom(O_U, E). H2: a reduction to one local isomorphism followed by one adjunction computation, written out in full.
